desc: Fruit by the Foot rolls are delightful fruit-flavored snacks made without any artificial flavors, offering a tasty gluten- and gelatin-free treat. Each foot-long snack contains only 80 calories and is a good source of vitamin C, making it a treat you can feel good about giving to your family. This pack contains a variety of flavors, including 24 Strawberry and 24 Berry Tie-Dye, totaling 48 delightful snacks.
features:
Two Tie-Dye flavors: Strawberry and Berry

48 individually wrapped 0.75‑oz rolls—convenient and portable

Gluten-free and gelatin-free — no artificial flavors or colors

Good source of Vitamin C (10% DV) per roll

Supports Box Tops for Education

Fun twist for kids' snacks, lunches, or on-the-go
ingredients: Sugar; Maltodextrin; Corn Syrup; Pear Puree Concentrate; Palm and/or Palm Kernel Oil.
